decisions.title: Exact declaration
decisions.decision: Retain static bool SchemaAtomics.TryGetProvenance(in XdmValue value, out ISchemaAtomicProvenance? provenance). No public attachment/registration factory or new required provider member.

decisions.title: Observation meaning
decisions.decision: True describes an engine-admitted cached declared/actual/origin tuple; it grants no lease, fresh provider ownership, current compatibility or permission to evaluate.

decisions.title: Plain and unknown
decisions.decision: Return false with null output for ordinary/computed/exact-numeric/markless atomized values, unknown markers and labels without authenticated transport. Never reconstruct by payload, QName or a global lookup.

decisions.title: Ordinary registered source
decisions.decision: A registered non-operation-bound typed scalar may be observed while its exact engine session/snapshot/cache remains live and its marker, ordinal, registration and payload still match. Return cached references only; do not call the issuer/provider.

decisions.title: Originless registered cell
decisions.decision: The same bounded ordinary registry policy permits OriginalAssessment=null. Never manufacture assessment/source lineage or merge originless and original cache keys.

decisions.title: Constructed receipt
decisions.decision: A genuine operation-local receipt may expose cached declared/actual types and null origin only while its exact raw operation and engine session remain active. After raw completion, close or cancellation return false/null.

decisions.title: Current-compatible entry
decisions.decision: Return false/null for operation-bound compatible payload entries in this context-free helper, even inside a caller operation. A stable entry has no current operation/proof identity. Never retain a prior issuer, introduce ambient authority, overwrite stable entries with the latest proof or use descriptive evidence as reproof.

decisions.title: Compatible requirement remains
decisions.decision: Context-aware provenance for compatible values is an open required route. Settle a separately leased observation/disposition before final freeze; the bounded helper refusal is not owner acceptance or a waiver.

decisions.title: Expired/malformed try result
decisions.decision: Known expired/closed/canceled engine observations, unregistered or rebound representations return false/null. Do not use blanket catches to hide unexpected engine defects or to execute provider callbacks speculatively.

decisions.title: Guarded observation object
decisions.decision: A future returned engine view exposes cached type/origin references, with callback-free engine lifetime checks on every getter. Retaining it after revocation must not continue to yield evidence. Obtaining opaque handles still does not authorize subsequent provider operations.

decisions.title: Provider callbacks
decisions.decision: The helper and its provenance getters never call provider/type/origin properties, Owns/IsSameComponent, compatibility proof, lazy getters, enumerators or native admission/release callbacks. Reference returns do not recursively guard arbitrary methods on returned provider objects; use them only under explicit owner/raw lifetimes.

decisions.title: Transport authenticity
decisions.decision: Recognize sealed engine transport only and validate exact payload/type tags without attachment, conversion, provider-defined equality or stringification. No XdmValue layout/friend/reference changes or public marker SPI are selected.

decisions.title: Legacy private kernel
decisions.decision: Opaque private SchemaEvidenceKernel markers are not automatically public-contract provenance merely because object fields can be cast. A separate authenticated adapter/disposition is required; bounded observation returns false until qualified.

decisions.title: Atomic versus container
decisions.decision: The helper observes one atomic carrier and never claims container GoverningType, IsList or cardinality. Preserve a container separately; an atomic observation cannot reconstruct its boundaries.

decisions.title: Empty lists
decisions.decision: Empty lists retain valid governing/list metadata at the complete-container boundary, have no atomic marker/provenance item, and consume zero per-atomic scalar slots. False for Undefined is not an invalid-list classification.

decisions.title: Singleton lists
decisions.decision: Do not infer scalar container shape from one atomic. Ordinary singleton-list registration keeps IsList in its container; an exposed cell may have its own provenance. Existing compatible/constructor list refusals remain explicit and unwaived for broader support.

decisions.title: Union selections
decisions.decision: Preserve per-cell cached declared and selected actual handles by reference and ordered origin; never replace all members by a container governing/union handle or infer a member from its primitive payload.

decisions.title: Complete bounded batches
decisions.decision: Validate the full ordered container, every cell and captured atom/numeric/cache limits before publication/commit. No prefix success, silent truncation, partial quota mutation or conversion of empty/list/multiple-atomic shapes into scalar success.

decisions.title: Flattened data
decisions.decision: Existing public original-node atomization remains its selected flattened plain-value route. Do not retroactively attach provenance or reinterpret existing returned graphs in this policy step; marker-preserving general transport is separate implementation work.

decisions.title: Admission remains mandatory
decisions.decision: Runtime typed use still requires exact session/snapshot/operation, complete ownership and current issuer checks. An observed tuple or provider-created SchemaAtomicItem cannot substitute for issued container identity or mint an engine marker.

decisions.title: Quota and concurrency
decisions.decision: Observation acquires no native lease, source/cache/typed-atom quota slot or ambient operation. Registration/close races must not publish unguarded evidence; implementation must define the callback-free linearization check. Storage/allocation cost must be measured, not assigned an owner budget.

decisions.title: No broad closure
decisions.decision: This policy closes only the Core design selection. Helper/container implementation, tests, Schema/other owner review, native resources/performance, C45/freeze and publication remain open.
